title: 第二百二十八章 偷袭补给站第二百二十七章 鹿久初露锋芒
lines: 第二百二十八章偷袭补给站
“这个计划的第一步就是先端掉沙忍的总补给站。”
听到了鹿久的话，夜天云和水门都有些疑惑，“难道还有第二步？”两人轻声问道。
鹿久笑了下，但随即脸色严肃起来：“不错，这第二步才是真正的关键。”
“天云，水门，你说如果我们打掉了沙忍的总补给站，接下来沙忍的反应会是如何？”
“背水一战。”水门接口道。
“不错！”鹿久朗声道，“他们不可能撤退，理由有三：其一是我刚刚提及的，风之国土地贫瘠，镇甸十分稀少，这一退就要退三四百里，沙忍不会甘心，其二是沙忍如今的领军叶苍，她是一个极其要强的女忍，对于村子也极其忠心，为了村子的尊严她不会轻易撤退，最后便是新晋的风影，面对晋为风影后的首次大战，他不会轻言放弃。”
“因此他们会拼死一战！”
“可是拼死一战我们与沙忍的人数相差太大！”夜天云摇了摇头，继而叹道：“想要战胜他们并不容易。”
鹿久笑了下，拍了拍夜天云的肩膀：“天云，你还是有些过于追求完美，战争和普通的战斗迥然不同，战争的每一次战斗，每一次对垒都是要做出长远的打算，如今战事刚刚开启，沙忍村真正的精英也在筹集，不要妄想在一开始就吃掉他们所有人。”
夜天云也知道自己有些过于钻牛角尖了，自嘲的笑了下，朗声道：“那鹿久大哥下步打算如何？”
“擒住叶苍，然后以叶苍为筹码，让沙忍退兵五百里！”
“擒住她？！”夜天云和水门有些惊讶。
“没错，端掉补给站断了沙忍的后路，若是平时我们将叶苍擒获反而会激起沙忍的怒火，但若是他们先失去了后勤保障，再失去了统帅，必定大乱。”鹿久沉声道。
“擒住她之后为什么不杀了她，一个灼遁的血迹使用者在战争中的作用不小啊。”夜天云问道。
“沙忍若是答应后退五百里，将叶苍放回去也无妨，若是真杀了她，沙忍一定会拼死一战，届时就不好收场了。”
“五百里，足够为我们赢得足够的喘息之机，让我们能筹措更多的部队，让我们能够加强我们的边防！”
“原来如此，是个连环计，但这计划的目的并不在于击败沙忍，而是为村子赢的时间。”听到了鹿久的话，夜天云和水门恍然大悟。
“好吧，既然如此作战计划就这样拟定，水门，偷袭补给站一事交给你如何？！”夜天云说道。
“放心吧，天云师兄！”
“别忘了，沙忍的援军后日便到，要尽快！”鹿久不忘提醒。
“放心吧。”水门应了一声，走出了营帐。
夜天云和鹿久看着离去的水门，一脸严肃，随即两人再度商量到一处，拟定着接下来的计划。
水门这次前去偷袭沙忍是孤身一人，毕竟营地中人数本来就有些吃紧，而卡卡西如今的实力虽不错，但这番任务是偷袭对方囤积物资之地，是对方重点防御的地方，一定有大量的精英忍者驻扎在那里，对于卡卡西来说太过危险了。

Chapter 228: Sneak Attack on Supply Depot
"The first step in this plan is to take down the Sand Ninja's main supply depot."
After hearing Lu Jiu's words, Ye Tianyun and Minato were a little confused, "Is there a second step?" they asked softly.
Lu Jiu smiled, but then his face turned serious: "Yes, this second step is the real key."
"Tianyun, Minato, what do you think the Sand Ninja's reaction will be if we destroy the Sand Ninja's main supply depot?"
"A last-ditch fight," Minato said.
"That's right!" Lu Jiu said loudly, "They can't retreat for three reasons: First, as I just mentioned, the land of the Kingdom of Wind is barren and there are very few towns. If they retreat, they will have to retreat three to four hundred miles. The Sand Ninja will not be willing to do so. The second is that the Sand Ninja is now The leader, Ye Cang, is an extremely strong kunoichi and extremely loyal to the village. For the sake of the dignity of the village, she will not retreat easily. Finally, there is the newly promoted Kazekage. Facing the first battle after becoming Kazekage, he will not give up easily. "
"So they will fight to the death!"
"But the difference in numbers between us and the Sand Ninjas in a desperate fight is too big!" Ye Tianyun shook his head, and then sighed: "It is not easy to defeat them."
Lu Jiu smiled and patted Ye Tianyun on the shoulder: "Tianyun, you are still a little too pursuit of perfection. War is very different from ordinary battles. Every battle and every confrontation in the war requires long-term planning. Now that the war has just begun, the real elites of Sand Ninja Village are also gathering. Don't try to eat them all at the beginning."
Ye Tianyun also knew that he was going too far, so he laughed at himself and said loudly: "What is Brother Lujiu's next plan?"
"Capture Ye Cang, and then use Ye Cang as a bargaining chip to make the sand ninja retreat five hundred miles!"
"Capture her?!" Ye Tianyun and Minato were a little surprised.
"Yes, taking away the supply depot will cut off the sand ninja's escape route. If we capture Ye Cang normally, it will arouse the sand ninja's anger. But if they lose their logistical support first and then their commander, they will be in chaos." Lu Jiu said solemnly.
"Why didn't you kill her after you captured her? A Bloodstain user of Burning Escape plays a big role in the war." Ye Tianyun asked.
"If the Sand Ninja agrees to retreat five hundred miles, there is no problem in putting Ye Cang back. If he really kills her, the Sand Ninja will definitely fight to the death, and it will not end well."
"Five hundred miles is enough to buy us enough breathing room to raise more troops and strengthen our border defense!"
"I see, it's a chain plan, but the purpose of this plan is not to defeat the sand ninja, but to gain time for the village." After hearing Shikaku's words, Ye Tianyun and Minato suddenly realized.
"Okay, since the battle plan is drawn up like this, Minato, how about I leave the sneak attack on the supply depot to you?!" Ye Tianyun said.
"Don't worry, Senior Brother Tianyun!"
"Don't forget, the sand ninja reinforcements will arrive the day after tomorrow, so we need to do it as soon as possible!" Lu Jiu reminded him.
"Don't worry." Minato responded and walked out of the tent.
Ye Tianyun and Lu Jiu looked at Minato leaving with serious expressions, and then they discussed together again and formulated the next plan.
Minato went to sneak attack the Sand Ninja alone this time. After all, the number of people in the camp was already a bit tight, and although Kakashi's current strength was good, this mission was to sneak attack the opponent's place where supplies were stored, which was the opponent's key defense place. There must be a large number of elite ninjas stationed there, which was too dangerous for Kakashi.
